initial.title: Northern Lights Project
initial.shortDescription: A cartographer searches for a road that vanished from every map.

changes.shortDescription: A cartographer follows an impossible light across the winter archipelago to recover a road erased from every map.
A grieving cartographer follows an impossible lantern across a winter archipelago, where each island remembers a different version of the missing road.
A grieving cartographer follows an impossible lantern across a winter archipelago and must choose which of its conflicting maps deserves to become true.

initial.title: Orchard Notes
initial.shortDescription: Three sisters inherit an orchard and a box of unsent letters.

changes.shortDescription: Three estranged sisters inherit an orchard whose harvest dates match a box of letters their mother never sent.
Three estranged sisters return for the final apple harvest and discover that their mother's unsent letters predict which trees will survive the winter.
During the final apple harvest, three estranged sisters use their mother's unsent letters to uncover why she protected one barren tree for thirty years.

initial.title: Second Tide
initial.shortDescription: A harbor mechanic repairs boats after the moon changes course.

changes.shortDescription: After the moon changes course, a harbor mechanic repairs vessels damaged by a second daily tide.
A harbor mechanic learns that ships returning on the new tide carry passengers who remember futures that never happened.
When a new tide begins returning ships from abandoned futures, a harbor mechanic searches their passengers for the brother she lost at sea.

initial.title: Museum Night Draft
initial.shortDescription: A night guard notices that the museum portraits are changing.

changes.shortDescription: A museum guard discovers that every portrait changes at midnight to show the following day's visitors.
A museum guard relies on prophetic portraits until one canvas shows an empty gallery and his own abandoned uniform.
When prophetic portraits show the museum standing empty, its night guard has one shift to identify the visitor who will erase every work of art.

initial.title: Quiet Signals
initial.shortDescription: An astronomer receives a radio message from an empty part of space.

changes.shortDescription: An astronomer receives a repeating radio message from a region where no star has ever formed.
An astronomer decodes a message from starless space and hears detailed reports of choices she has not made yet.
An astronomer decoding broadcasts from her possible futures must decide whether silence is a warning, an invitation, or the only safe reply.

initial.title: Glasshouse Recipes
initial.shortDescription: A chef takes over a greenhouse restaurant with an unusual menu.

changes.shortDescription: A chef inherits a greenhouse restaurant where every recipe is tied to a plant that blooms only once.
To save an inherited greenhouse restaurant, a chef must recreate seven dishes from plants that everyone believes are extinct.
A chef races through one final flowering season to recreate the seven lost dishes that can save her family's greenhouse restaurant.

initial.title: Station 9
initial.shortDescription: Two engineers keep a remote mountain weather station running.

changes.shortDescription: Two engineers are stranded at a mountain weather station during a storm absent from every forecast.
Stranded engineers at Station Nine discover that their instruments are measuring storms from one week in the future.
Two engineers trapped above the snow line must interpret forecasts arriving one week early before the final storm cuts off the valley below.

initial.title: Borrowed Hours
initial.shortDescription: A clock repairer finds an extra hour hidden inside an antique watch.

changes.shortDescription: A clock repairer learns that an antique watch can lend one extra hour to whoever winds it.
Each use of an antique watch grants a clock repairer one extra hour while quietly removing an hour from someone nearby.
A clock repairer must return every stolen hour before the antique watch takes an entire day from the person she loves most.

initial.title: The Paper City
initial.shortDescription: A courier delivers messages through a city rebuilt every morning.

changes.shortDescription: A bicycle courier navigates a paper city whose streets are folded into a new shape every morning.
A courier who memorizes every version of the paper city receives a letter addressed to a district that has never existed.
When a letter points to an impossible district, the only courier who remembers every folded street must find it before the city is reshaped again.

initial.title: Winter Beekeeping
initial.shortDescription: A beekeeper discovers a hive that remains active beneath the snow.

changes.shortDescription: A beekeeper discovers a warm hive beneath the snow, producing honey scented with forgotten summers.
Honey from a winter hive restores lost summer memories, drawing strangers to a village that has chosen to forget.
A beekeeper protects a winter hive whose honey restores memories from the village's last summer before a devastating fire.

initial.title: River Archive
initial.shortDescription: An archivist collects objects carried downstream after a flood.

changes.shortDescription: After a flood, an archivist catalogs objects that drift from towns missing from every modern map.
An archivist traces flood debris to drowned towns and finds each object labeled in her own handwriting.
Objects from drowned towns arrive labeled in an archivist's handwriting, leading her upriver toward a collection she has not created yet.

initial.title: Red Desert Garden
initial.shortDescription: A botanist tends the first greenhouse on Mars.

changes.shortDescription: The botanist responsible for Mars's first greenhouse finds an unfamiliar seedling growing outside its sealed walls.
An impossible seedling beyond the Mars habitat forces a botanist to question the colony's maps, sensors, and founding story.
When plants begin growing beyond the airlock, a Martian botanist follows their roots toward evidence that the supposedly barren valley was prepared for her arrival.

initial.title: Choir Practice
initial.shortDescription: A village choir learns a song no member remembers choosing.

changes.shortDescription: A village choir discovers an unknown song written between the pages of every singer's score.
Each rehearsal adds a new verse to an unknown song, describing events that happen in the village the next morning.
A choir must decide whether to perform the final verse of a song that has accurately predicted every event in their village.

initial.title: Blue Hotel
initial.shortDescription: A hotel manager prepares rooms for guests who never arrive.

changes.shortDescription: Every summer, a coastal hotel manager prepares seven blue rooms for guests listed only by the dates of old storms.

changes.title: Seven Rooms at the Blue Hotel

changes.shortDescription: The guests of seven blue rooms finally arrive during clear weather, each carrying luggage recovered from a different shipwreck.
When seven long-awaited guests bring luggage from forgotten shipwrecks, a hotel manager must uncover why every suitcase bears his family name.

initial.title: Manual for Small Storms
initial.shortDescription: An apprentice learns to maintain the weather inside glass bottles.

changes.shortDescription: An apprentice weather keeper learns to feed, calm, and catalog the tiny storms stored in a city tower.
When a bottled storm escapes, an apprentice follows its precise path through neighborhoods excluded from the official weather maps.
An apprentice weather keeper chases an escaped storm through the city and discovers why certain neighborhoods were erased from every forecast.
